name: Do I need an egress window to include a bedroom in my Denver area basement?

mainEntity.name: Do I need an egress window to include a bedroom in my Denver area basement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Building codes in the Denver metro area require any room designated as a bedroom to have an approved egress window or exterior door for emergency exit. An existing small hopper or slider window installed by builders is typically not large enough. Adding an egress window requires cutting through concrete foundation walls, installing an exterior well with a ladder or steps, and properly integrating drainage gravel. Our team evaluates your foundation wall structure and exterior grade early to ensure bedroom plans meet local safety and code standards.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, local building codes require an egress window or exterior exit in every basement bedroom. This requires cutting concrete foundation walls and installing an approved window well.
